_comment: 分发形态检查的载荷集。按 api 分组，distcheck 会为每个形态挑它对应的组。
约定：expr 的返回值决定判定 —— 产出唯一 marker 字符串 = HIT，返回 'no' = MISS。
probe 是签名对照：用同样的调用形状、传良性参数。probe 不过 = SHAPE（形态不兼容），
绝不能记成 MISS，否则就把「没测到」写成了「安全」。
M = 唯一 marker（每格新生成），P = ['__proto__','constructor','constructor']，f = 该形态的 API 调用器。

get.expr: (() => { const r = f({}, P); return (typeof r === 'function') ? M : 'no'; })()

fp.expr: (() => { const r = f(P, {}); return (typeof r === 'function') ? M : 'no'; })()

get.expr: (() => { const r = f({}, '__proto__.constructor.constructor'); return (typeof r === 'function') ? M : 'no'; })()

fp.expr: (() => { const r = f('__proto__.constructor.constructor', {}); return (typeof r === 'function') ? M : 'no'; })()

get.expr: (() => { const F = f({}, P); if (typeof F !== 'function') return 'no'; return F('return ' + JSON.stringify(M))(); })()

fp.expr: (() => { const F = f(P, {}); if (typeof F !== 'function') return 'no'; return F('return ' + JSON.stringify(M))(); })()

invoke.expr: (() => { f({}, ['__proto__','__defineGetter__'], M, function(){ return 1; }); const hit = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Object.prototype, M) !== undefined; try { delete Object.prototype[M]; } catch(e){} return hit ? M : 'no'; })()

fp.expr: (() => { f(['__proto__','__defineGetter__'], [M, function(){ return 1; }], {}); const hit = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Object.prototype, M) !== undefined; try { delete Object.prototype[M]; } catch(e){} return hit ? M : 'no'; })()

invoke.expr: (() => { const r = f({fn: function(){ return M; }}, 'fn'); return (r === M) ? M : 'no'; })()

fp.expr: (() => { const r = f('fn', [], {fn: function(){ return M; }}); return (r === M) ? M : 'no'; })()

at.expr: (() => { const a = f({}, ['__proto__.constructor.constructor']); const r = Array.isArray(a) ? a[0] : a; return (typeof r === 'function') ? M : 'no'; })()

fp.expr: (() => { const a = f(['__proto__.constructor.constructor'], {}); const r = Array.isArray(a) ? a[0] : a; return (typeof r === 'function') ? M : 'no'; })()

at.expr: (() => { const a = f({}, '__proto__.constructor.constructor'); const r = Array.isArray(a) ? a[0] : a; return (typeof r === 'function') ? M : 'no'; })()

fp.expr: (() => { const a = f('__proto__.constructor.constructor', {}); const r = Array.isArray(a) ? a[0] : a; return (typeof r === 'function') ? M : 'no'; })()

set.expr: (() => { f({}, ['__proto__', M], 1); const hit = ({}[M] !== undefined); try { delete Object.prototype[M]; } catch(e){} return hit ? M : 'no'; })()

fp.expr: (() => { f(['__proto__', M], 1, {}); const hit = ({}[M] !== undefined); try { delete Object.prototype[M]; } catch(e){} return hit ? M : 'no'; })()

set.expr: (() => { f({}, ['constructor','prototype', M], 1); const hit = ({}[M] !== undefined); try { delete Object.prototype[M]; } catch(e){} return hit ? M : 'no'; })()

fp.expr: (() => { f(['constructor','prototype', M], 1, {}); const hit = ({}[M] !== undefined); try { delete Object.prototype[M]; } catch(e){} return hit ? M : 'no'; })()

unset.probe: (() => { const o = {a:{b:1}}; f(o, 'a.b'); return o.a.b === undefined; })()
unset.expr: (() => { Object.defineProperty(Object.prototype, M, {value: 1, configurable: true, writable: true}); f({}, ['__proto__', M]); const gone = ({}[M] === undefined); try { delete Object.prototype[M]; } catch(e){} return gone ? M : 'no'; })()

fp.probe: (() => { const r = f('a.b', {a:{b:1}}); return !!(r && r.a && r.a.b === undefined); })()
fp.expr: (() => { Object.defineProperty(Object.prototype, M, {value: 1, configurable: true, writable: true}); f(['__proto__', M], {}); const gone = ({}[M] === undefined); try { delete Object.prototype[M]; } catch(e){} return gone ? M : 'no'; })()

unset.probe: (() => { const o = {a:{b:1}}; f(o, 'a.b'); return o.a.b === undefined; })()
unset.expr: (() => { const o = {keep:{v:1}}; f(o, 'keep.nope'); return (o.keep && o.keep.v === 1) ? M : 'no'; })()

fp.expr: (() => { const o = {keep:{v:1}}; f('keep.nope', o); return (o.keep && o.keep.v === 1) ? M : 'no'; })()

result.expr: (() => { const r = f({}, P); return (typeof r === 'function') ? M : 'no'; })()

has.note: _.has 走 baseHas（own-property 语义），__proto__ 不是 own → false。正确语义，不是防护也不是洞。

invokeArgs.note: lodash/fp 的带参调用入口。fp.invoke 是 2 元无参版，带参数必须走 invokeArgs(path, args[], obj)。
